## About
Elite Bmers & Benz is an independent repair center in Spring, Texas for people who drive BMW, Mercedes Benz, MINI and Porsche vehicles. Our goal is simple: consistent, high quality repair and service at a reasonable price.
We stand behind our work. We will always offer you our honest and most economical approach, and we are happy to give you your old parts and, when it applies, show you the failure.
You will find us on Louetta Rd near the Champions area, close to St. Luke's Medical Center, Willowbrook Mall and Vintage Park Shopping Village. Stop by Monday through Friday and meet our staff.

## Services
- Repair for BMW, Mercedes, MINI and Porsche: Efficient, quick repairs on the makes we know best, at a price that is fair.
- Maintenance: Ongoing maintenance for your car, so you can keep coming back to a shop that knows it.

## FAQ
Q: Which cars do you work on?
A: We focus on BMW, Mercedes Benz, MINI and Porsche vehicles.

Q: Can I get a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: Customers mention that we are willing to offer a ride so you do not have to wait while repairs take place. Just ask when you drop off your car.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., and closed Saturday and Sunday.
